Main Circuit
Deadlift – BB
3 x 10BarbellModerate
Logged weight (if necessary)✓
From James, for you: Set your feet - whole foot on the floor - then shoulders, core and lift.

Start: Stand with feet hip-width, the bar over mid-foot. Hinge down to grip just outside your legs, shins to the bar, chest up, back flat, shoulders slightly ahead of the bar, core braced hard.

Movement: Push the floor away and stand tall, keeping the bar dragging close to your legs, hips and shoulders rising together. Finish standing tall with the glutes, then hinge the hips back and lower the bar under control down the same line.

Focus: The back stays flat from floor to lockout, never rounded. Take the load through the legs and hips and keep the bar close to the body throughout. Don't jerk the bar or lean back at the top, just stand tall.

Hip thrust – BB
3 x 10Barbell/Bench20kg
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell across the front of your hips. Feet flat, hip-width, shins vertical when the hips are up. Tuck the chin slightly and brace the core.

Movement: Drive through your heels and push the hips up until the thighs are level and the body makes a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top, hold, then lower with control.

Focus: Finish the lift with the glutes at a straight line, don't over-arch the lower back to gain height. Keep the ribs down and the chin tucked so the movement stays in the hips, not the back. Shins stay roughly vertical at the top.

Box squat – goblet
3 x 8KB/DB/Box2.5kg
Logged weight (if necessary)✓
From James, for you: Feet face forward. Push hips back. Stop knees caving in.

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

Bulgarian split squat
2 x 10 eachBenchBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓
From James, for you: Keep knees out.

Start: Stand a stride in front of a bench, the top of your back foot resting on it, torso tall, arms for balance.

Movement: Lower straight down by bending the front knee until the thigh is towards parallel, then drive up through the front heel to the start.

Focus: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, not caving in, and most of the weight through the front leg. Keep the torso tall, control the descent, and go only as deep as the front knee stays comfortable.

Wall slides
3 x 10WallBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, feet a few centimetres out so the lower back stays flat, elbows bent to 90 degrees in a goalpost.

Movement: Slide the arms slowly up towards overhead keeping every point of contact, then slide back down under control.

Focus: Keep the whole back and both arms on the wall throughout. The moment the lower back arches or the hands lift away is your limit, so work just short of it, and breathe steadily.

Scapular retraction and depression
10BodyweightBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Sit or stand tall, arms relaxed at the sides, ribs down, neck long.

Movement: Draw the shoulder blades back and down together, hold briefly, then release under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades back and down, away from the ears, not shrugging. Keep the neck long and the ribs down, and move slowly and deliberately.

Standing external rotation – DB
3 x 12 eachDB1.5kg then 3kg
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Stand tall, upper arm pinned to the side, elbow bent to 90 degrees, a light dumbbell held with the forearm across the front.

Movement: Rotate the forearm outward to the side, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned to the side and move only the forearm. Keep the shoulder down and use a light weight, controlling the whole range.

Reverse fly – DB
2 x burn eachDB3kg
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in each hand hanging below the chest, elbows softly bent.

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft bend in the elbows and lead with the backs of the hands, squeezing the shoulder blades. Keep the ribs down and don't swing or shrug, and use a light weight for control.

Bottoms-up KB carry
3 x 20 m eachKB2.5kg
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Hold a kettlebell upside down at the shoulder, bell balanced above the fist, wrist straight, ribs down.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the bell balanced upside down.

Focus: Keep the wrist straight and the bell balanced, which demands grip and control, and the ribs down. Keep the shoulder down, take steady steps, and use a light weight.

w/c 10 Aug 2026 · Shoulder Baseline▼
Pendulum swings

Start: Stand and lean forward with one hand resting on a support, the other arm hanging relaxed and free.

Movement: Let the hanging arm swing gently in small circles and back and forth, letting gravity move it, relaxed.

Focus: Keep the arm relaxed and let it swing loosely rather than driving it with muscle. Keep the movements small and gentle, easing the shoulder without forcing.

2 x 30s each · Bodyweight
Wall slides

Start: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, feet a few centimetres out so the lower back stays flat, elbows bent to 90 degrees in a goalpost.

Movement: Slide the arms slowly up towards overhead keeping every point of contact, then slide back down under control.

Focus: Keep the whole back and both arms on the wall throughout. The moment the lower back arches or the hands lift away is your limit, so work just short of it, and breathe steadily.

3 x 8 · Bodyweight
Wall push-up plus

Start: Stand facing a wall, hands flat on it at shoulder height and width, arms straight, body in a line leaning in slightly.

Movement: Bend the elbows to bring the chest towards the wall, press back, then at the top push a little further to round the upper back (the plus), then relax.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging at the hips. Keep the shoulders down, and on the plus let the shoulder blades spread rather than shrugging up.

3 x 10 · Bodyweight
Shoulder press – standing

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, ribs down, glutes and core braced.

Movement: Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight, then lower back to the shoulders under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and squeeze the glutes so the lower back doesn't arch as you press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and press within a comfortable range.

3 x 8 · 5kg
Reverse fly – DB

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in each hand hanging below the chest, elbows softly bent.

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft bend in the elbows and lead with the backs of the hands, squeezing the shoulder blades. Keep the ribs down and don't swing or shrug, and use a light weight for control.

3 x 12 · 2.5kg
Scapular retraction – seated

Start: Sit tall, arms relaxed or bent at the sides, ribs down, neck long.

Movement: Draw the shoulder blades back and together, hold briefly, then release under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades together without shrugging up towards the ears. Keep the neck relaxed and the ribs down, and move slowly and deliberately.

3 x 12 · Bodyweight
Straight arm raise – plate

Start: Stand tall holding a plate in both hands at the thighs, arms straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Raise the plate forward and up to about shoulder height with straight arms, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with straight arms and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Keep the ribs down and don't lean back, and control the lower.

2 x burn · 5kg
Side-lying external rotation – progressive load

Start: Lie on your side, the top elbow pinned to the ribs and bent to 90 degrees, a light dumbbell held, forearm across the tummy.

Movement: Rotate the forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned and move only the forearm, progressing the weight only slightly at a time. Keep the shoulder down and control the slow lower.

3 x 12 each · 1.5kg
DB pullover

Start: Lie on a bench holding a single dumbbell over the chest with both hands, arms fairly straight, ribs down, feet planted.

Movement: Lower the dumbbell back overhead in an arc to a comfortable shoulder stretch, then pull it back over the chest.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back as the arms go overhead. Keep the arms fairly straight, go only to a comfortable stretch, and control the arc.
